summary: Reference-counted resource release. Returns -2 immediately if the release-blocking flag bit (this+0x9C bit 2) is set. Otherwise decrements both ref counts at this+0x84 and this+0x88; if this+0x88 is still non-zero it returns -2 (more references outstanding). When the count reaches zero it iterates the sub-resource slots at this+0xA8 (count this+0xA4), finds each slot's node in the linked list headed at this+0xB8, decrements that node's reference count, and when it reaches zero destructs its per-element data (count at node+0x4C), removes the node with DoublyLinkedListNodeRemovalWithArrayCleanup, and zeroes the slot pointer. Finally ORs this+0x9C with 3 and returns 0.

local_names.v2: decremented remaining ref count at this+0x88
local_names.v3: sub-resource slot pointer, advancing 37 dwords per slot from base this+0xA8
local_names.v5: sub-resource node pointer stored in the slot (at this+0xA8 + 0x8C)
local_names.v4: linked-list walk node starting from the list head at this+0xB8 + 0x28
local_names.v7: sub-resource node pointer re-read before element destruction
local_names.v8: element index used to walk and destruct per-element data
local_names.v11: sub-resource slot loop counter, bounded by this+0xA4

operations.description: Release-blocking check: if bit 1 of the flags at this+0x9C is set, return -2 immediately without touching ref counts.
Decrement both ref counts: this+0x84 and this+0x88 are each reduced by 1.
If the remaining count this+0x88 is still non-zero, return -2 (further references are alive).
Outer sub-resource loop only runs when the slot count this+0xA4 is greater than 0.
Walk the sub-resource slots starting at this+0xA8, advancing 37 dwords (148 bytes) per slot, once per slot in this+0xA4.

Match the slot's node pointer (stored at the sub-resource slot offset 0x8C) against the linked list headed at this+0xB8: walk nodes from list-head + 0x28 following the next pointer at dword index 23 until a match or the end of the list.
Decrement the matched node's reference count (field 0x0 of the sub-resource node); when it drops from 1 to 0 the node is freed.
Per-element destruction only runs when the node's element count (at node + 0x4C) is greater than 0.
Loop over the node's elements in 24-byte steps, calling DestructorWithConditionalFreeFlagClear on each element pointer.
DoublyLinkedListNodeRemovalWithArrayCleanup unlinks the node from the linked list and cleans up its backing array.
Zero the sub-resource slot pointer at the node (this+0xA8 + 0x8C), marking the slot released.
On successful release OR the flags at this+0x9C with 3, marking the resource as released/cleaned.
Return 0 on a fully completed release.
